body.en:
Question B-001-013-003.

Why the correct answer is right: Station identification is done by transmitting the station call sign.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "Your \"handle\"": A handle may be friendly operating shorthand, but it is not the regulatory station identifier.
- sourceIndex 2: "Your first name and your location": First name and location can help conversation, yet they do not replace the call sign.
- sourceIndex 3: "Your full name": A full personal name identifies a person, not the amateur station in the required way.
